data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence as the true workflow (DEALS, Deals & Promotions, open the All Regions selector, pick a region) and uses the same region parameter. It also adds an "Open amtrak.com" step and describes the dropdown a little differently, and the final step is slightly vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
